reviewer: Isolated reviewer plus trusted cycle compiler/behavior gates

functions.reason: An independent pinned MSVC build with /O2 /Oy- /GS- produced a complete 70-byte compiler section identical to the original Game.exe bytes. The reference assembly also matched those bytes. I independently ran the submitted 1,260-case test against the compiled section and bytes extracted directly from the original; it passed, covering growth and overflow branches, request comparisons, and untouched object and buffer state. The member-function ABI and original instructions agree. This certification concerns the routine, not a complete executable rebuild.

limits: Complete native compiler fragment and byte-checked reference tested at relocated addresses
Sampled tests independently reviewed for the specific routine; not all-input equivalence or a full game run
Original 32-bit ABI; external calls/relocations require a separate qualified recipe
